notes.title: Boundless Paths launches on 10 Apr 2024!
notes.content:
[h1]Boundless Paths[/h1] is an Exploration Tower-Defense Roguelike. Find resources, reveal encounters, adapt defenses, and enjoy endless replayability with procedural map/path generation and a quest/prestige system.

[h1]Features include:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Procedurally generated maps, paths and waves to manage and adapt to.
[*] Exploration to find resources and events, with multiple ‘breadcrumb’ mechanics to locate them.
[*] Unique towers and upgrades to choose from.
[*] Spells powered by ever larger sacrifices of life as a resource instead of just a game-over counter.
[*] Monster variety with 9 distinct abilities, including counter attacking player towers
[*] Strategic choices on when and where to trigger boss waves to conquer the map.
[*] Complete challenging quests to unlock towers, spells, new bonus mechanics and a late-game enchantment shop.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624475/0c2a0087f3d51dd36fc332562e7bfd1138881608.png[/img]

Thanks for your interest! I hope you’ll enjoy this game as much as I did making it.
15% discount at launch!

notes.title: Version 0.5 to 0.8 Highlights
notes.content:
[h2]Map Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Ruins Feature - can be removed for 50 gold or food to become plains (for placing towers) 
[*] Added Scrying Stones feature - choice to get info on nearest treasure, lair, gold or food
[*] Improved exploration interactivity with multiple ‘hint’ mechanics and features leading players to map features eg. flowers/mushrooms, rumors, scrying stones
[*] Procedural generation algorithms to even out map difficulty from path loopiness to map feature distribution.
[/list]
[h2]Sound/Music[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tower attack sounds now have improved variety and simultaneity. Replaced many other sound effects. 
[*] Music - Added and replaced many music tracks, and smoothed out transitions
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scout Window - interactive illustrated display of incoming monster wave.
[*] Tutorial - Improved clarity, illustration, scripting.
[*] New button designs and font sets to match the fantasy theme.
[*] More compact UI elements/design, freeing up map display
[*] Main Menu - improved splash screen and icons
[*] Codex - Added illustrated strategy guides
[*] Animated notifications for daily summary, base damage, income and spellcast.
[*] QOL - Added mouse pan/zoom, right-click Escape
[/list]
[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tower models & particle effects - all replaced, with separate models/effects for each tower upgrade branch.
[*] Upgraded models for trees, monsters, roads and many map features.
[*] Improved many UI textures (Stats, quest, codex, bestiary, spawn arrow etc)
[*] Towers and Forts now pitch black to indicate destruction.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] New mechanics - execute, targeting options, spell scaling
[*] Monster wave design - improved variation and distribution amongst paths
[*] Steam Cloud support
[/list]

[h2]Way ahead[/h2]
[list]
[*] SteamNext Fest (Feb 5-12) participation and public Demo
[*] Late-game features - Enchantments, larger maps, more Quest Sets, classes, monsters (new abilities)
[*] Steam Achievements, Trading Cards.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.5 & 0.6 Patch note summary
notes.content:
Monster/Tower rebalancing towards fewer but stronger monster spawns. 
i) Includes multiple changes to every tower upgrade path, monster stats & abilities, and some mechanics (beam upgrades).
ii) Changed monster spawn order to random instead of by tier. Also added randomization/variety to wave design, so that each path sometimes has different monsters

Map Generation
i) Soft-control of spread of resources and plains tiles to build towers, reducing reliance on luck.
ii) Added flowers near food tiles and mushrooms near metal tiles, to make exploring less RNG and more entertaining.
iii) Forests near plains now have less trees, making it easier to find plains tiles.

Quest rebalancing 
i) Enabling both very early and late game meta-progress by giving all ‘General’ Category quests 10 levels.

Sound
i) Sound//Video options now accessible in Main Menu, not just in-game/map
ii) Improved transitions, quality and variety.

Visuals, UI and QOL
i) All tower models replaced, including aura, projectile and impact effects. Different models when upgrading towers along each branch. 
ii) Added Scouting Window, showing upcoming wave spawns as clickable bestiary icons/numbers, instead of previous text-based scouting report. Minimizable.
iii) Monster targeting options added for relevant towers - first, last, close, strong, weak
iv) Improved tutorial and related guidance features such as codex, bestiary, popups, animated notifications etc
v) Main Menu makeover.

[h2]Version 0.4 - Beautified monsters, menus, tower attacks, animations etc.[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Changed and upgrade most of the monster 3d models and animations.
[*]     Changed and improved many of the tower attack/aura visuals for all 7 towers+paths

[*]     Beautified (inc. adding images) windows for quest, class select, global buff, codex

[*]

[*]     Map tooltip no longer goes out of map for tile features at the edges.
